requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to streamline business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need easy-to-use, efficient tools to manage printing workflows without dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and AI solution infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for productivity, scanning, and device management are available and functional for SMB users. Usability validated by non-IT office managers.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver the lowest TCO in HP's business printer lineup, minimizing intervention and maximizing efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top purchasing driver for SMBs with limited budgets.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on consumable pricing, maintenance model, and supply chain management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent cost analysis shows Magellan has the lowest TCO compared to other HP business printers.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a replaceable maintenance box that allows end users to perform maintenance without service technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs lacking IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design changes and supply of maintenance kits.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace the maintenance box following provided instructions; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic, surpassing key competitors in sustainability.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental responsibility is a growing requirement for businesses and offers a competitive advantage.
requirements.Dependencies: Material sourcing and manufacturing process changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and certification confirm 60% RCP in final product.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal (SMB portal) for managing multiple printers, targeting unmanaged or lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables easy device management for offices without IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software development and integration with printer firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal enables registration, monitoring, and management of all Magellan devices in an office environment.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing via HP App, supporting modern work environments and BYOD scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile device usage is prevalent in SMBs; enables flexibility and convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices using the HP App with no additional setup.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80,000 Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, to align with SMB expectations.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs seek reliability and predictable service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and honored in all launch markets.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Supplies
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink supplies to prevent errors and ensure only compatible supplies are used.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces risk of incorrect refilling and ensures product reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All supply bottles are uniquely keyed and cannot be misused with other products.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Design for serviceability: customer replaceable parts (PHA) and MINK at service center, with threshold target for customer replaceable items.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and reduces service costs for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and documentation of replaceable/serviceable parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Parts designated as customer-replaceable are documented and validated via service manuals.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Features
requirements.Description: PDL SKU to support print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improvement from current 25/19), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Meets higher performance and environmental standards required in certain markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware updates, certification testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves targeted print speeds, supports PDL/PS, and is Blue Angel certified.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View Portal
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKU to support SMB2.0 solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, as well as Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables differentiated feature sets for different market segments and supports new business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU is shipped with SMB2.0 solutions and Advanced View Portal enabled, and supports PaaS.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' AI solutions to optimize print and scan quality automatically.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers superior user experience and reduces manual intervention for quality issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software development and integration with printer hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print and scan outputs are optimized automatically and validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry to collect usage, performance, and diagnostic data, supporting proactive support and product improvement.
requirements.Rationale: Enables data-driven support, remote diagnostics, and continuous improvement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, transmitted securely, and used for product insights; compliant with data privacy regulations.
